newsitem.title: USA: Conseco closes American Life acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Conseco closes American Life acquisition.

text.p: Conseco Inc said Tuesday it has completed its previously announced acquisition of American Life Holdings Inc, a provider of retirement savings annuities, for $165 million in cash.
Conseco said it paid the other limited partners in Conseco Capital Partners II L.P. $23 for each of their shares of American Life Holdings.
As previously announced, Conseco plans to move American Life Holdings' operations from Des Moines, Iowa, to Carmel, Ind. in mid-November, resulting in about $10 million of annual cost savings.
Conseco has said its objective is to be a leader in each of its major product lines: supplemental health insurance, retirement savings annuities, and universal life insurance.
Conseco also said it expects to complete by year-end its proposed acquisitions of American Travellers Corp, Capitol American Financial Corp, and Bankers Life Holding Corp and Transport Holdings Inc.
Conseco owns and operates life insurance companies and provides investment management, administrative and other fee-based services.
Shares of Conseco were trading off 3/8 to 48-7/8.
